reply.statement: Rejected. The implementation always appends a charge for every valid request, so retrying the same key and payload mutates the ledger instead of returning the original receipt without another charge. It also fails to return 409 without mutation when the same key is reused with a different amount. The visible checks only establish the first-charge status/count and retry status; they do not verify retry charge count, ledger immutability, conflicts, distinct-key independence, or all invalid-input behavior.
